question: Does old frozen phase-response prediction transfer from cardinal to previously unseen oblique phases on the same16 backgrounds?

design.question: Does old frozen phase-response prediction transfer from cardinal to previously unseen oblique phases on the same16 backgrounds?
design.source_role: Reuse exact16 fresh-transfer backgrounds4954300..4954315. NO new independent sources claimed. Eight new oblique input phases per source; phases never inflate n.
design.coefficients: Byte-identical old-only frozen_predictors.json copied from transfer4954300. Only center19.2 zero, bounded scalar, complexlinear and fullH. Same finite-horizon19.2 basis. NO fits, frequency shifts, per-source oracle, or new predictor selection.
design.primary: Native: for each model (1) oblique scalar NMSE minus fullH NMSE; (2) oblique fullH NMSE minus cardinal fullH NMSE. Four paired-source contrasts,16384 common type-stratified source bootstrap draws seed4954500; nominal95 and family4 Bonferroni98.75 percentile intervals. No equivalence claim from nonsignificance, no automatic threshold.
design.descriptive: Locked policy; each baseline zero/scalar/complex/fullH; each of8 angles per source retained. Cardinal4 and oblique8 scores each pool actual waveform error over all angles before dividing by total ideal signal energy. No per-angle ratio averaging for primary.
design.odd_even: Opposite pairs i,i+4 for oblique and i,i+2 for cardinal. Save raw odd differences and even sums relative to background; each frozen predictor error splits into odd residual plus even energy. No new fit. Input antipodal FP32 closure is measured.
design.controls: Previous frozen capture repeat, normalizer endpoint-state parity, self-patch and same-batch replay; after capture require exact new-vs-saved cardinal background forecast parity, all four model/policy settings. Checkpoint/code/input/old-predictor hashes; finite checks.
design.limitations: A finite eight-angle holdout can expose cardinal aliasing but cannot establish a globally linear phase law; higher harmonics can alias even this grid. Conditional on same16 synthetic sources, fixed amplitude.1 and32-step horizon. Output-frequency distortion may contribute shared error; no forecasting repair, absent-information or patch-causality claim.
design.native_capture: Reuse frozen response_phase_transfer.run/worker/capture_bank, forecasts only with transient endpoint-state identity checks.
design.grant_contract: No grant created by prepare. Native entry points require explicit external coordinator slot grant bound to this exact protocol; queue behind Plato32freshcausal and Popper64electricity.
